questions.prompt: Describe how resistive and infrared touchscreens detect a touch.
questions.model_answer: Resistive: pressure makes two conductive layers touch. Infrared: touching the screen interrupts light beams across its surface.
questions.grading_criterion:
1: Resistive: pressure makes two conductive layers touch.
1: Infrared: touching the screen interrupts light beams across its surface.
